Move the ESS shared service account off a static credential
Reconcile production deployment approvals with the written two-approval procedure

Document the RIS maintenance-window handoff between the on-call and platform rotations
Write down the RIS branch and review conventions that are currently held by convention
Re-run the privileged-access review and record the result against the published standard
